question: True or false: The Simpsons clip of Donald Trump riding an escalator aired before he launched his 2016 campaign?
answer: False. Trump rode down the Trump Tower escalator to announce his run on 16 June 2015; the animated short Trumptastic Voyage, showing a similar descent, came out in July 2015. A 2000 episode did joke about a President Trump, but the famous clip followed the event it seemed to foresee.
move: Check the date on a prophecy before admiring its accuracy.
trap: Trusting a clip because it matches the later event so exactly.
reference: The Simpsons, Trumptastic Voyage, animated short, Fox, July 2015; and Bart to the Future, season 11, Fox, 2000
